Game Overview

In Throw Bomb, the core idea is straightforward: step into a nostalgic 80s-inspired arcade world with Throw Bomb. Engage in stickman battles where precision and strategy rule. Master your aim and force to outwit enemies. Every level demands sharp timing and accuracy, offering progressively tougher challenges in this explosive journey. Unleash mayhem, one bomb at a time!
